test_check_version: test the check_version function to verify if an installed package satisfies a version requirement like numpy>=1.20.0
test_parse_version: test the _parse_version function to parse a version string into comparable tuple components
build_version_check: build a version check utility that validates installed package versions against requirements using operators like >=, <=, >, <, ==, !=
create_version_parser: create a version parser that splits version strings into numeric and non-numeric components for tuple comparison
run_version_validation: run version validation on a package spec string to confirm the installed version meets the specified constraint
